stories.title: The Elusive Choreographer Sarah Michelson Is Turning MoMA Into a Dance Palace
stories.source: The New York Times — Art & Design

stories.title: Touils Turns Memory Into Landscape

stories.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
stories.sum: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.
